title: Research Outpost Lab (two-story)
summary: A reusable, enterable TWO-STORY research lab for PowerWorld: ground floor (front entrance, flank breach panel, entry-lab + case room), an inter-storey floor slab (upper floor = lower ceiling), an upper floor (two rooms + windows), a switchback stair ground->upper->roof, and an accessible roof. Breakable front door, flank weak wall, one upper-floor panel and one roof panel; bounded debris. Stable-ID wall/floor/opening colliders with a level field, intact/breached states. No invisible box across any opening; per-camera fade (never global roof removal) is the third-person visibility model.

units.gameConversion: 1:1 — authored directly in world units; metres are documentation only.
units.derivation: Measured from runtime: src/engine/citytiles.js door() DH=11.2u = '2.1m' -> 0.1875 m/u; 9.6u human = 1.8m.

axes.note: Origin = footprint ground-centre, floor plane y=0. Entrance faces +Z; breach flank +X. Runtime places by a world (x,z) centre + yaw.

fitting.note: Native fitting reference measured from runtime source constants.
fitting.soldierHeroHeightSource: citytiles metric comment; SARGE/MERC are Fighters at the same radius
fitting.largeHeroSource: CLAUDE.md frame audit (RAGE 12.47u tall, OLYMPUS 9.44u wide)
fitting.chaseCamNote: Approx lateral room a third-person chase boom wants around the player indoors before it must collapse to shoulder-cam. Used by the fixture to check per-floor entry-room comfort.

storey.note: Floor-to-floor = clearHeight + slabThickness = 16.0u. L0 floor y0, ceiling underside 14.8; L1 floor y16, ceiling underside 30.8; roof deck top 32.0; parapet top 34.2. Per-floor clear 14.8u (2.78m): clears the 11u collision head + the 12.5u silhouette + chase-cam headroom.

stairs.note: Ground -> upper, in the FRONT -X bay running -Z. The floor-2 slab is OPEN over the whole run (a real stairwell shaft) so a climbing fighter has full headroom; you emerge onto the solid upper floor at the top of the run.

Upper -> roof, in the REAR -X bay running +Z toward the centre. The ROOF slab is OPEN over the whole run; you emerge onto the solid roof deck. Stair B stands on the solid upper floor (its bay is not part of stair A's shaft).

floorPanels.note: A breakable panel in the UPPER FLOOR over the ground entry-lab. A heavy hero smashes down through it from the upper floor into the ground floor (a 'selected floor piece').

weakPanel.note: Breakable roof panel over the upper rear room; smash down from the roof into the upper floor.

front_door_leaf.note: Ground front-door leaf; opening stays passable, only the leaf mesh breaks.

breach_panel.note: Ground flank weak wall; a superhero breaches it; structural walls (hp 1200) cannot be shot through.

upper_floor_panel.note: Upper-floor smash panel (floor-from-above into the ground floor).

roof_weak_panel.note: Roof smash panel (into the upper floor).

structural.note: Load-bearing desert sand; effectively unbreachable by fire — 'cannot shoot through intact walls'.

floor_struct.note: Inter-storey floor slab (upper floor = lower ceiling).

floor_slab.note: Thin ground slab, cosmetic; terrain at y=0 is the real ground floor.
